## What managing Morton Grove takes.

### Aging buildings, planned capital work
Long-established condominium and townhome communities need reserve studies that match reality and a phased capital calendar. We coordinate bids and oversee the work with no separate capital-project management fee on top of our flat monthly rate.

### Commuter-friendly communication
With Metra service into downtown Chicago, many owners are away during the day. Portal-first notices, online payments, and clear written follow-up keep everyone informed without relying on lobby notices.

### Cook County taxes and budgets
Morton Grove associations sit in Cook County, where reassessment years change owners' tax bills. We help boards explain budget changes clearly and coordinate property-tax appeals with counsel where they are worth pursuing.
